description: R11 one-tail centroid-distance CDF, generic R8 numerical evaluator reused

tier01_top1_diff_g_vs_b0.target: >= +0.05 (+5.0 percentage points, exact count 20 * (G_hits - B0_hits) >= n)

whole100_non_worsening.target: >= 0.0 (all100 top1 difference G vs B0, exact count G_hits >= B0_hits)

tier01_top1_exceeds_random.target: Tier01 G top1 hit rate > Tier01 G actual-pool random expectation

gate_failures: tier01_top1 paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound (-0.05357142857142857) <= 0.0
tier01_top1 hit rate (0.0167) does not exceed Tier01 random expectation (0.0234)

rule_diagnostics.distance_history_definition: all raw_distance_available values in strict past [t-720,t), independent of legacy score/geometry; at least 24 values and 3 floor(ts/24) dates
rule_diagnostics.self_cdf_definition: (#past distances < current + 0.5 * #exact-equal) / n; one-tail high CDF, no 1-CDF or two-tail rarity
rule_diagnostics.peer_cdf_definition: equal-vessel mean of each eligible other same-known-single-gear peer's one-tail CDF at current distance and same query t
rule_diagnostics.reference_window: [t-720,t); current and future excluded; each historical distance value may itself use coordinate history reaching back to t-1440

G_self_tie_diagnostics.comparison: same s4 pool; self_distance_cdf remains primary; compare with peer secondary enabled vs omitted
